faqs.a:
Subject to any limitations in the Colorado Uniform Electronic Transactions Act, by
               submitting a proposal to a city-issued solicitation for goods or services, a bidder
               agrees to the use of electronic signatures. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the city
               may require that any proposal be executed with manual signatures.
(Ord. No.
4774
, § 1, 8-16-2021)
